# VeilVoice

![VeilVoice](https://github.com/tilas01/veilvoice/raw/main/assets/banner.png)

Irreversible voice de-identification, fully offline. It destroys the biometric voiceprint, pitch, formants, timbre and accent, and leaves the speech transcribable.

This wiki is generated from the repository. Every page here has a source file there, and CI fails if the two disagree, so nothing on it can quietly go stale.
